question: If my sister's mother-in-law's only son is Devika's father, how is Devika's paternal grandfather related to my sister?
solution:
By using the symbols in the table given below, we can draw the following family tree:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e70b8fc59f55523cbd1c0dcb6157cdd0120d14d1918de4106bf11139640dba2e.png] 

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aa383d9d8141ac0d8847935cf7f152ce20b60f8300f35cd85bc6abdbac79f5aa.png] 

Clearly, Devika's paternal grandfather is father-in-law of my sister.

Hence, ‘**Father-in-law**’ is the correct answer.
